title: Massless spinning fields on the Light-Front: quartic vertices and amplitudes
summary: Within the light-front approach in flat space, we study the closure of the Poincaré algebra at the quartic order, specifically the non-holomorphic constraint involving both MHV and anti-MHV vertices. We first recover some well-established results: the existence of Yang-Mills theory and gravity, as well as the inconsistency of interacting multi-graviton theories. We explicitly construct several lower-derivative and lower-spin quartic vertices. We then turn to theories involving massless higher-spin fields. It becomes evident that the quartic constraint does not allow many cubic interactions…
